heading: 4.4 No `unit prefix` declaration
text:
### 4.4 Prefixed units are declared [LUNI.4.4]

All prefixed unit names
(kilogram, milliampere, megohm, kilometre, MHz, kPa, etc.) are declared
explicitly in the standard library with their correct canonical names and
aliases.

Unit symbol resolution is simply: look up the symbol (or alias) in the
module's import scope. If not found: compile error. Authors who need a
unit not in the standard library declare it explicitly.
